entities.name: Ruko
entities.description: Tiger warrior and chief of scouts from Efrava on Dominaria.

entities.name: Jedit Ojanen
entities.description: Arrested by Ruko for bringing a human into Efrava.

entities.name: Johan
entities.description: Human who disliked Ruko and set him on fire.

entities.name: Efrava
entities.description: Homeland of the tigermen on Dominaria.

events.summary: Ruko arrests Jedit Ojanen for bringing a human into Efrava.
events.quote: going as far as arresting Jedit Ojanen for bringing a human into their homeland

events.summary: Johan escapes and casts Immolation on Ruko's spear, burning him to death.
events.quote: which caused the whole tigerman to catch fire and burn to death

relations.quote: Johan made certain to cast Immolation on Ruko's spear
